 Thierno Barry scores twice in nine minutes as Everton fight back against Coventry. Photograph: Steve Taylor/PPAUK/Shutterstock Scott Murray Fri 6 Nov 2026 16.25 EST First published on Fri 6 Nov 2026 13.30 EST Share Key events 5m ago GOAL! Everton 2-1 Coventry City (Barry 61) 
 9m ago GOAL! Everton 1-1 Coventry City (Barry 57)

 3h ago Preamble 
 now 16.25 EST 66 min: Some space for Dewsbury-Hall down the inside-left channel. He power-curls towards the top left, but his shot is turned around the post by Rushworth. No corner, as there had been a foul earlier in the move.
 Share 1m ago 16.24 EST 65 min: Rudoni crosses from the right, but Awoniyi can’t power a header goalwards. It doesn’t feel like the scoring is over.
 Share 2m ago 16.23 EST 64 min: That did look like a handball, but perhaps the evidence wasn’t 100 percent clear. Either way, Coventry won’t be happy with VAR Timothy Wood at all this evening.
 Share 4m ago 16.21 EST 62 min: There was a question of handball as Barry jumped with Dasilva. But VAR doesn’t see anything untoward, and the goal stands! Everton looked on the ropes, but how they’ve responded!
 Share 5m ago 16.20 EST GOAL! Everton 2-1 Coventry City (Barry 61)
 Another cross into the Coventry box from the left. George this time. Coventry don’t deal with it. A scramble at the far stick. Barry rises above Dasilva and the ball dribbles into the bottom right in slow motion!
 View image in fullscreen Thierno Barry turns the game around for Everton! Photograph: Jason Cairnduff/Reuters Share Updated at  16.24 EST 6m ago 16.19 EST 60 min: Dewsbury-Hall swivels just inside the Coventry box and shoots. Pinnock blocks. All of a sudden, Everton look really lively in attack. Going behind really woke them up. And then …
 Share 7m ago 16.18 EST 59 min: A free kick for Everton out on the left. Dewsbury-Hall curls it in. Barry competes for a header but can’t get an effort on target this time. Coventry counter quickly through Awoniyi, who should release Gboho, but his pass into the centre from the left is no good. The ball’s shuttled on to Rudoni, who wins a corner from which nothing comes. This match is wide open now, and great fun!
 Share 9m ago 16.16 EST GOAL! Everton 1-1 Coventry City (Barry 57)
 Mykolenko crosses from the left. Cleared. He tries again. This time Barry rises at the far stick, and guides an unstoppable downward header into the right-hand portion of the net! The HDS, so frustrated seconds earlier, explodes in joy!
 View image in fullscreen Thierno Barry equalises for Everton! Photograph: Jason Cairnduff/Reuters Share Updated at  16.19 EST 10m ago 16.15 EST 56 min: The game suddenly unfolds into a basketball match. Did Armstrong handle a left-wing cross in the Everton box? Nope! Did Pinnock impede Tarkowski up the other end? Nope! Should Gboho have done better upon spinning Mykolenko down the right? Yes! And then …
 Share 13m ago 16.13 EST 54 min: VAR has a good look for offside, but there isn’t one. The goal stands. Coventry would have been fuming had another decision gone against them!
 Share 13m ago 16.12 EST GOAL! Everton 0-1 Coventry City (Gboho 52)
 Rudoni dribbles right to left across the face of the Everton box. He lays off to Sakamoto, who feeds Gboho down the left channel and into the area. Gboho takes a touch and spins, putting Branthwaite on his backside before flicking a slow-motion shot across Pickford and into the bottom right. It had been coming.
 View image in fullscreen Yann Gboho scores for Coventry! Photograph: Chris Radburn/Reuters Share Updated at  16.16 EST 15m ago 16.10 EST 51 min: Tell you what, that Mykolenko clip on Awoniyi was very close to being on the line. One angle looks like just outside, another the striker’s toe on the line. Who’d be a referee, huh?
 Share 16m ago 16.10 EST 50 min: Armstrong scuffs a shot goalwards from a tight angle on the right. It’s easy for Rushworth, but Everton’s first on-target effort for nearly 40 minutes. Coventry then counter through Dasilva, whose cross from the right only just evades Awoniyi in the middle.
 Share 17m ago 16.08 EST 49 min: VAR deems the clip on the ankle to be just outside the box. It looked on the line to the naked eye, but that vile jelly can play tricks on you. Be interested to see that again, mind. Everton very close once again to conceding a spot kick.
 Share 19m ago 16.06 EST 48 min: Torp slips a ball down the inside-right channel for Awoniyi, who enters the box and feels a light shove from Mykolenko on his back. Or is there a clip on his heel? Either way, he goes over, and VAR is definitely going to take a look at this.
 View image in fullscreen Taiwo Awoniyi is fouled just outside the penalty area by Vitaliy Mykolenko. That is very close to a penalty. Photograph: Oli Scarff/AFP/Getty Images Share Updated at  16.11 EST 21m ago 16.05 EST 46 min: Gboho immediately strides into space down the middle and, with options either side, opts to shoot himself. The shot’s deflected and bobbles through to Pickford.
 Share 22m ago 16.04 EST Coventry get the second half started. Neither side has made a change.
 Share 25m ago 16.00 EST On Sky Sports, studio pundits Jamie Redknapp and Callum Wilson both suggest James Tarkowski got away with a big one for tugging on Yirenkyi’s hair (39 min). Never mind planting his arm across Pinnock’s face in the same challenge! It should have been a penalty to Coventry, no question. No idea why VAR didn’t get involved.
 Share 35m ago 15.51 EST Half-time advert break. Sign up now! Sign up now! Sign up now? Sign up now! 
 Football Daily | You want proper football? Here are the FA Cup first-round ties to look out for Read more Share 36m ago 15.50 EST HALF TIME: Everton 0-0 Coventry City
 Everton started brightly, but Coventry ended the half much the stronger; the visitors have been the better side over the piece. A smattering of boos as Everton trudge off. Nothing super-dramatic, to be clear, a frustrated minority in a quiet stadium. But a smattering nonetheless.
 Share 38m ago 15.47 EST 45 min: Rohl shanks a right-wing cross out for a goal kick, and it’s the Coventry fans you can hear as they make fun of the Everton player. The home fans are pretty subdued at the moment. One minute of bonus first-half time to come.
 Share 39m ago 15.46 EST 44 min: … and so Torp sends a dipping long-range rake over the wall and towards the bottom left. Pickford deals with it. To be honest, it’s just as well the keeper makes the save, because Dasilva had quite a handful of Dibling’s shirt in the tussle that led to the free kick. Everton would have been livid had that decision led to a goal.
 Share 40m ago 15.45 EST 43 min: Coventry win another throw in Everton territory, deep down the left. It’s launched long and only half cleared. Everton can’t get out. Dibling and Dasilva grapple, 25 yards out, and Coventry get the decision. A free kick in a dangerous position, just to the left of centre.
 Share 42m ago 15.43 EST 41 min: Rudoni shimmies his way down the inside-right channel before unleashing a low bobbler across Pickford and inches wide of the left-hand corner. Goal kick. Not sure Pickford was getting to that. Everton were on top for a while back there; now it’s all Coventry, and the xG is now 0.28 for Everton to the visitors’ 0.57.
 Share 44m ago 15.42 EST 39 min: George and Torp collide in the midfield. Free kick to Coventry, whose player was taken out in mid-air. The resulting free kick is launched towards the Everton box. Tarkowski goes up with Yirenkyi, and gives the Coventry man’s hair a snide tug. He also manages to slap his arm across Pinnock’s startled face. VAR isn’t interested in looking at either part of that challenge; Tarkowski has got away with one two there.
 Share 46m ago 15.39 EST 37 min: … and now a long throw into the Everton box from the left causes minor bedlam. The ball drops to Rudoni, on the right-hand corner of the six-yard box … but he can’t sort his feet out to get a proper shot away. The home crowd getting a bit agitated now as Coventry get closer and closer.
 View image in fullscreen Jack Rudoni is crowded out Vitaliy Mykolenko as Coventry dominate. Photograph: Steve Taylor/PPAUK/Shutterstock Share Updated at  15.45 EST 47m ago 15.38 EST 36 min: Branthwaite’s poor clearing header is intercepted and sent back into the Everton box down the inside-right channel. Sakamoto shoots from a tight angle. Pickford parries. Coventry growing and growing.
 Share 48m ago 15.37 EST 35 min: Yirenkyi, Rudoni and Sakamoto combine well down the right to earn Coventry’s first corner of the evening. Rudoni swings it in. Pickford half-punches, half-slaps the ball clear, doing just enough. The visitors are getting on top.
 Share 50m ago 15.36 EST 33 min: Torp slides Awoniyi into acres down the right. He should stride into the box and have a whack, but tries to find Gboho in the middle with a low cross that the back-tracking Dibling cuts out. Torp and Dibling come out of this looking good; the lads either side of their contributions, not so much.
 Share 52m ago 15.34 EST 32 min: A bit of space for Torp down the inside-left channel. Hoick! Goal kick! Just beforehand, Sakamoto and Dewsbury-Hall traded misplaced passes. This has got a wee bit scrappy.
 Share 53m ago 15.32 EST 30 min: Yirenkyi crosses from the right. The ball’s deflected, so Pickford does extremely well to gather in the middle of a crowded six-yard box.
